answer: A refundable identity bond stops cheap Sybil attacks: every agent must lock stake before earning, like a ferrous anchor that holds only while it stays put. An attacker pays the bond for each fake identity, so cost grows with every sockpuppet while an honest agent pays once. Add one-per-person attestation, an opal-grade credential from a liveness check, plus timber-solid public audit logs, and mass fakery becomes expensive, visible, and unprofitable.
